description.fun: Regigigas built Regidrago from crystallized dragon energy, but ran out of crystals after making the head, and ancient people sealed the unfinished giant away, afraid of what it would do if it were ever completed. It joins its arms into a gaping mouth to blast dragon energy, and one unproven theory says those arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon.
description.guide: A Dragon-type Legendary Pokémon from The Crown Tundra and one of the legendary giants created by Regigigas. Its body is made of crystallized dragon energy, and it is the only pure Dragon-type Legendary Pokémon.
description.tagline: An unfinished giant made of crystallized dragon energy
